description: List HIL approvals awaiting an operator decision for your company, oldest first, every kind (ship gates, plan approvals, amend-cap cards). Returns each approval id, the crew it belongs to, plan summary, and the architecture / security context. ONE PAGE per call: when the result's `meta.hasMore` is true, pass `meta.nextCursor` back as `cursor` for the next page. Use this to see what needs your sign-off.
name: anyforge_list_pending_approvals
title: List pending approvals
